_readme: THE APPLE AGE-RATING DECLARATION — app `{{app_id}}`, channel `ios-appstore`. STAMPED UNANSWERED.
Apple requires age-rating answers on every submission from September 2026. This file is the
repo-native record of those answers, and a submitter retypes them into App Store Connect.
IT RECORDS ANSWERS, NOT A RATING. Apple COMPUTES the rating from the answers, so there is no
`assignedRating` key in this template and you should not add one. A rating written here before
the declaration is submitted would be a value nobody computed, sitting in the repository looking
authoritative. The answered copy carries `assignedRating: null` until Apple returns a real one —
which is also why the key is absent HERE: every null in this template means 'a question you still
owe an answer to', and the rating is not a question you may answer at all.
⛔ NEVER GENERATE THIS FILE. [ADR 037]: a sworn declaration regenerated by a template is a
statement nobody made. tooling/app-yaml/render.mjs must never write it, and this template exists
to be a BLANK yardstick — never a source the answered file is rendered from.
HOW TO FILL IT IN: answer every `null` below, then work `unresolved` to empty. Each claim is a row
in `claims` carrying `id`, `attributes` (the Apple attribute names it answers), `answer`, `claim`
(the sentence you are swearing to), `derivation` (how you know) and an optional `note`. Where the
same behaviour is already answered in store/android-play/content-rating.json, derive it from there
rather than re-deriving it — one app, one set of behaviours, and a second measurement of the same
thing is how the two drift apart. Where nothing in the tree can tell you, say `stated-not-derived`
rather than dressing a product fact up as a measurement.
AUDIENCE FLOOR: [ADR 068] sets it at 18 and forbids Families/Kids declarations, so `kidsAgeBand`
is answered null BY DECISION rather than by omission — record the decision, not a blank.

unresolved.question: questionnaireWording — are the Apple attribute names in `claims[].attributes` the ones THIS account's App Store Connect actually shows?
unresolved.how: Read the live `ageRatingDeclaration` resource for an existing app record via the App Store Connect API. Until one app record exists there is nothing to read, and the names come from Apple's published reference rather than from the account — record which of the two it was, and that the live set wins.

unresolved.question: claims — is every attribute Apple asks about answered, and does each answer name how it was derived?
unresolved.how: Work the questionnaire top to bottom. For each row set `derivation` to `same-subject-as-play` (carried from android-play/content-rating.json), `dependency-tells` (measured off the dependency set or the call sites), `decision` (a recorded ADR) or `stated-not-derived` (a product fact with no tell). A row with no derivation is unre-checkable by whoever reads it next.

unresolved.question: in-app purchases and advertising — do the answers still match what the app SHIPS?
unresolved.how: Both change with the business model rather than with the code, so neither has a stable dependency tell. Re-read the billing decision and the ads declaration (store/android-play/ads-declaration.json) and answer from those, citing them.

unresolved.question: humanOwned — has a person confirmed they will retype these answers into App Store Connect?
unresolved.how: Set it true only when that is true. Nothing in this repository submits the questionnaire; the answers reach Apple because somebody types them.
